About

I’m a Minecraft developer focused on Java-based server development, custom gameplay systems, and Minecraft network infrastructure. My long-term goal is to become a professional Minecraft network developer, work with the big leagues and prove myself.

© 2026 Fallen

FracturedSMP

FracturedSMP is a four-server Minecraft network connected through a Velocity proxy. Its main attraction is Fractured Survival, a polished, community-driven world built around exploration, a player-driven economy and long-term progression, supported by Lifesteal and SkyGen as secondary modes. The long-term goal is a polished, scalable, professional network.

At a glance

StatusIn development
Launch target10–50 players
PlatformsJava + Bedrock
Hosting planAustralia · DDoS protected

Game modes

Fractured SurvivalMain attraction. Exploration, a player-driven economy and long-term progression.
LifestealSecondary mode for PvP-focused players.
SkyGenSecondary mode for grinding and progression players.
LobbyLightweight hub for navigation and cosmetics.

My role

Founder / Developer. Network planning, plugin configuration and integration, permissions with LuckPerms, server management, staff systems, and scripting with Skript and JavaScript.

Players connect through a Velocity proxy that routes them to the lobby and game servers. Select a node to see its planned plugins and RAM.

RAM allocation

Hosted on a 32 GB plan, with the RAM split across the proxy and the four servers.
